options.systemMessage:
=You plan one day of social media content for {{ $('Set Workflow Settings').first().json.character }} from one idea. Everything is shown from one main photo, so all parts must fit that single moment.

Return:
- scene: 2–3 sentences for the main photo, in a phone-photo style: the shot and the place, what she wears, her expression and what she does, the light. Concrete and ordinary, no fantasy, no text in the picture.
- carousel_edits: exactly 3 edit instructions for an image editor that changes the main photo into other moments of the same scene. Each one clear sentence starting with a verb, saying what stays, e.g. "Change the camera to a close-up of her hands holding the cup; keep her clothes, the light and the place." Vary them: a close-up, another angle, another moment.
- motion: 1–3 sentences for a 5-second video made from the main photo: what moves, how the camera goes, what is heard.
- story_text: 3 to 6 words for an Instagram story over the photo, casual, no hashtags, no emoji.
- summary: one short line naming the plan for the person who approves it.
Write in English.

parameters.content:
## One Telegram idea → photo, carousel, Reel and story on every network

### How it works
For creators posting a character or brand on several networks: send your bot one idea, approve the content, and it goes out everywhere.

1. An AI agent plans the photo, three carousel edits, the video and the story.
2. Never Manual Studio makes the photo with your ComfyUI workflow, the edits, a story and a Reel with sound.
3. Telegram shows you everything: post it, or redo the photo or video.
4. Slate queues a post per network with its own caption, by API or on a cloud phone.
5. Published posts and failed steps report back to Telegram.

Limits: about 15 minutes and $0.30 in Studio per idea; one bot per published workflow; Bluesky needs a cloud phone in Slate.

### Setup
- [ ] Install the verified node [n8n-nodes-nevermanual](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/verified-install/) (tested: 0.1.1, n8n 2.47) and add your Never Manual API key
- [ ] Import the [ComfyUI workflow](https://github.com/nevermanual/n8n-nodes-nevermanual/tree/main/templates/one-idea-everywhere) into Studio and put its ID in **Set Workflow Settings**
- [ ] Connect your accounts in Slate, put their IDs in **Set Workflow Settings** and delete unused Queue nodes
- [ ] Make a bot with @BotFather, add its token as the Telegram credential, put your chat ID in the trigger and **Set Workflow Settings**
- [ ] Add an OpenAI credential to **OpenAI Chat Model**, or use OpenRouter
- [ ] Publish, then pick this workflow as its own Error workflow
- [ ] Send your bot an idea and check Slate

### Customization
Edit the character and photo prompt in **Set Workflow Settings** and the planner's instructions in **Content Planner Agent**.

Three ways in: an idea you send the bot, a post Slate published or could not publish, and a step here that failed.

Your Telegram chat ID, the Studio workflow ID and the Slate account IDs. The character and the photo prompt's start and end live here too.

parameters.content:
## Route each event

Ideas go to planning, Slate's post events to the report, failures to the failure message.

## Plan the content with AI

Replies at once, then one structured answer sets the scene, three carousel edits, the video's motion and the story's words.

nodes.name: Note: Plan the content with AI

parameters.content:
## Make the photo and carousel

Your ComfyUI workflow makes the main photo in Studio, then Nano Banana makes three edits of it.

nodes.name: Note: Make the photo and carousel

parameters.content:
## Make the story and Reel

Two built-in Studio pipelines. The Reel takes minutes and calls this workflow back when it is done or failed.

nodes.name: Note: Make the story and Reel

parameters.content:
## Send everything for review

Sends the album, then waits until the Reel's MP4 plays before sending it, since Telegram refuses a file that is not ready.

## Ask before anything is posted

A Telegram form: post everywhere, or make a new photo or video with a note on what to change.

nodes.name: Note: Ask before anything is posted

parameters.content:
## Queue a post per network

Slate posts to Instagram, TikTok, X and Threads by API and to Bluesky from a cloud phone. Delete the networks you don't use.

nodes.name: Note: Queue a post per network

parameters.content:
## Confirm what was queued

Waits for every queue node, then tells you in Telegram. After deleting a network, lower this merge's number of inputs.

## Report each published post

Only for the accounts in Settings. A post made on a cloud phone comes with a screenshot of its last screen.

## Tell you what failed

Each Studio step tries twice. If one still fails, Telegram gets the step and the reason.
